system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Message visibility is filtered based on FSM state, ensuring agents receive only messages relevant to their role and phase.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent focused prompts; retrieved context injected. Mechanism of system prompt not described.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: retrieve relevant context from memory and metadata, construct ex-ecution DAGs
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval of memory/metadata (pgvector) plus agents receive schemas, summaries and sample rows from remote executor.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Summarizers: Distill intermediate results into compact summaries for downstream agents, enabling context mini-mization without losing decision-relevant information.
context_compaction.note: Tool outputs remain in remote execution layer; only summaries return.

observation_format.evidence_quote: agents perceive summaries, schemas, and sample rows rather than full datasets or API responses
observation_format.note: Inter-agent messages are Pydantic-typed structured messages; format of LLM-facing content not specified.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Rather than agents directly calling tools and ingesting full responses, they write code that executes remotely

tool_count.note: Paper mentions 50+ agents, 32 data writers, 50+ transformation primitives, but no tool schema count.

tool_schema_source.note: Agents invoke MCP servers from code, not via schemas exposed to the model.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: they write code that invokes tools like MCP servers

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The execution sequence follows a fixed pattern:Planner first, Critics last, with iterative loops in between.
loop_primitives.note: FSM routing; critic rejection triggers retry; event-sourced SessionLog and cooperative message passing kernel.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The planner generates an execution DAG with pre-declared success criteria and acceptance gates.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Decision-making follows a strict hierarchy, never horizontal consensus.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Handoff pattern: Agents delegate to specialists; PlanMan-ager routes to PlanExecutor→ CodingInnerLoopTeam→ Critics
delegation_mechanism.note: Also structured message passing; executor may spawn sub-agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: No execution proceeds without human sign-off on the plan and its criteria.
human_in_loop.note: Policy violations escalate to user gate for approval; users review final outputs (user rejection).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the entire ordered state of all agents (including their con-text, reasoning, intermediate results, and execution status) is completely serialized

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Persistence: Vector memory (PostgreSQL + pgvector) cap-tures insights; indexed by scope (account/user/session); se-mantic search across all prior analyses

state_persistence.evidence_quote: users can return days or weeks later to re-sume from the exact checkpoint

self_verification.evidence_quote: writers and critics run on different model providers to achieve cognitive diversity and avoid monoculture
self_verification.note: Code, Chart, Output, Plan critics with veto; code executed in Jupyter.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This loop repeats until critics approve or escalation occurs.
retry_policy.note: Persistent failure escalates to user; model upgrade on critique failure.

rollback.evidence_quote: users can time-travel backward to any previous checkpoint to undo changes

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This loop repeats until critics approve, criteria are met, or persistent failure triggers escalation to the user.
termination_condition.note: Termination via critic approval / escalation; no step/cost caps reported. Closest value.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Writers start with fast, economical models; upgrade only on critique failure.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Transformation code and tool invoca-tions execute in isolated environment

permission_model.note: Policy violations escalate to user gate.

replayability.evidence_quote: Each checkpoint represents a complete, reproducible snapshot of the multi-agent system state.

eval_hooks.note: No repo; evaluation on production sessions.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Policy violations (guardrails triggered, security constraints violated, compliance checks failed) immediately escalate to a user gate for explicit ap-proval before proceeding.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Our evaluation covers financial analysis ex-clusively.

open_source.note: No repository given; production system by Isotopes AI.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Different agents can use different providers, matching model strengths to task re-quirements.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This paper describes the architecture of such a system in practice

first_release_date.note: Paper v1 date fallback; no repo.

pinned_version.note: No repo; coded from paper v1.
